ops.text: Final accounting of the daemonkit-v0.14 upgrade gaps (stacked-diff E2E, all hit in sequence on a pre-migration ~/.cc-review/v1): (1) services.db — controller StatePath, no schema-upgrade path by design, every command fails "missing bucket" client-side; (2) a wedged v0.25.0 daemon holding daemon.sock that EOF'd even its own version's handshake and needed SIGKILL-level manual removal; (3) processes.db — ProcessPath reaper records fail "unsupported durable process record schema" at daemon boot because cc-review's runtime config doesn't pass daemonkit's ArchiveUnsupportedSchema policy (the hook exists — controller.go:41-46 — cc-review just doesn't set it, unlike the review store at daemon.go:117). Recommended fixes for the migration workstream: set the runtime UnsupportedSchema policy to archive, add a services.db bucket-backfill or guided archive, and surface a remedy hint in the client error.
